span.exact_text: وأولى الأقوال في ذلك عندي بالصواب أن يقال: إن الله تعالى ذكره أخبر أن مُبغض رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم هو الأقلّ الأذلّ, المنقطع عقبه, فذلك صفة كل من أبغضه من الناس, وإن كانت الآية نـزلت في شخص بعينه.

translation_review.lexical_finding: In Lisan al-Arab, عقب is used for a man's offspring/descendants; this supports reading المنقطع عقبه as having one's line of descendants cut off.
translation_review.candidate_gloss_for_reviewer: cut off in his line of descendants
translation_review.status: research note only; not a finalized translation
translation_review.caution: Review the full clause together with الأقل الأذل and preserve Tabari's general-scope statement and exception that revelation may have concerned a particular person. Lexical evidence does not replace comparison with an identified English witness.
